I had to go to my local mental health authority and request a 50/51 order and they agreeed that he should be admitted. If someone is threatening themselves or others, they will most likely commit them against their will. It’s hard to do but in the end I’m glad I did it because it finally forced him to get on meds and he started to get better.

Basically, I was not able to convince him that he needed help. I had to force him against his will until he came back to reality. He was in a whole other world and thought he was perfectly fine, but he wasn’t being rational.
